# Wiki sync status

Which pages still need copying into the live Wiki. See [`README.md`](./README.md) for how the
mirror works.

**You do not edit this file.** Say which pages you have pasted and it gets updated for you.

**Reading it:** a page is in sync when its file has not changed since the commit in "Synced at".
Anything newer means it has drifted and needs pasting again.

## What changed across every page

- **A title and a one-line summary** at the top, so a reader knows in three seconds whether they are
  on the right page. No page had a title before.
- **Navigation footers deleted** — `_Sidebar` does that job now and cannot rot.
- **62 absolute wiki URLs converted to relative links**, per this project's own rule.
- **One name for the app.** It was `_CRT_`, `CRT`, "the application", "the app" and
  "Classic Repair Toolbox" — sometimes on the same page. Now always `CRT`.
- **Typos fixed**: "data data files", "There are are", "versionized", "architechture",
  "ressources", "focussing", "NET 10".
